composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Validate required fields first, so a missing/blank field is a 400 listing the
# offending field names before any entity is built or persisted.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateNewOwner
  next: uniqueTelephone

# Reject a create whose normalized telephone is already used by another owner (409),
# before any entity is built or persisted.
uniqueTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateUniqueTelephone
  next: uniqueHousehold

# Reject a create that shares a household with an existing owner — same last name at the same
# address (case-insensitive, whitespace collapsed) — with a 409, unless the request set
# 'sharesHousehold' true. Runs before any entity is built or persisted.
uniqueHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateUniqueHousehold
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

          title: Last name

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison

          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. When true, allows creating this owner even though another
            owner has the same last name at the same address (same household); otherwise
            such a create is rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:

              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true

      type: object
      properties:
        type:

          format: uri

          title: Title

          example: NoResourceFoundException

        status:

          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true

          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

      required:
        - message

**Shared-identifier assignment** (`ValidateUniqueHousehold.java`)
- A household = same last name at the same address (case-insensitive, whitespace collapsed) — unchanged basis.
- No existing member → nothing to reject, publishes an empty identifier.
- Existing member + no opt-in → 409 (unchanged).
- Existing member + `sharesHousehold: true` → computes a **stable** id (first 12 upper-case hex of SHA-256 of normalized lastName+address, so it's order-independent), back-fills any existing members missing it (and saves them), and publishes it via a dedicated `HouseholdId` record variable.

**Stamping the new owner** (`BuildOwner.java`)
- Reads the published `HouseholdId` (`@Val`) and sets it on the newly built owner when non-blank.

**Wiring** (`owners.POST.yml`)
- Added `govern: [ transaction ]` to the `uniqueHousehold` step since it now persists back-filled members, so the whole pipeline commits together.

In the test flow: owner `a` is created plainly; `b` joins → `a` and `b` get id `H`; `c` joins → finds `a`/`b` already at `H` → `c` gets `H`. So `b` and `c` return the same non-blank `householdId`, as asserted.
